overall_notes: The paper focuses on document-level machine translation with dynamic context selection using reinforcement learning. The metadata extraction was mostly accurate but needed normalization of dataset names and simplification of model nomenclature. The paper only uses BLEU for automatic evaluation and does not conduct human evaluation of translation quality.
